verifications.explanation: Every proposition in the claim is stated in the source. The central assertion — that all twelve participants incorporated support-related peer feedback into their second drafts — is supported by "By comparing their first and second drafts, it was found that all students incorporated support-related peer feedback and made substantial revisions in their second drafts", where "all students" refers to the twelve recruited participants. The paired-samples statistic is supported verbatim: "A paired t-test (t(11) = 6.51, p < 0.000, Cohen's d = 1.62) of paper ratings from the first to the second draft shows paper ratings improved by a mean of 1.1 points (out of 7)". The t(11) degrees of freedom confirm the paired-samples design with twelve participants, and the effect size and mean improvement match the claim exactly. No assertion is contradicted, no peripheral assertion is absent, and no hedge is removed.
